questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “A letter is written by Ravi.”
questions.explanation: Rule: the agent after 'by' becomes the subject; 'is written' (present) becomes 'writes'. Ravi writes a letter.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The thief was caught by the police.”
options: The police had caught the thief.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'was + V3' becomes simple past V2. The police caught the thief.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The song was sung by Meena.”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'was sung' becomes simple past 'sang' (V2, not V3).
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “Sambar is prepared by the cook.”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'is + V3' becomes simple present V1(s). The cook prepares sambar.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The project will be finished by Arjun.”
options: Arjun will have finished the project.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'will be + V3' becomes 'will + V1'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The window was broken by Anil.”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'was broken' becomes simple past 'broke'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The cake has been baked by Divya.”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'has been + V3' becomes 'has + V3'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The plants are watered by the gardener.”
options: The gardener is watering the plants.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'are + V3' becomes simple present; singular subject 'gardener' takes 'waters'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The match was won by India.”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'was won' becomes simple past 'won'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “She is loved by all.”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'is loved' becomes simple present 'love' with plural subject 'all'; the subject 'She' becomes the object 'her'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “He was seen by her.”
questions.explanation: Rule: swap subject and object, using 'She' as subject and 'him' as object; 'was seen' becomes 'saw'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “We are taught English by Mr. Iyer.”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'are taught' becomes 'teaches'; the subject 'We' becomes the object 'us'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The letter is being typed by the clerk.”
options: The clerk is typing the letter.
The clerk was typing the letter.
The clerk has typed the letter.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'is being + V3' becomes 'is + V-ing'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The exam had been conducted by the university.”
options: The university has conducted the exam.
The university had conducted the exam.
The university had been conducting the exam.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'had been + V3' becomes 'had + V3'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “Has the bill been paid by you?”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Has + O + been + V3 + by S' becomes 'Have + S + V3 + O'; 'you' takes 'Have'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “By whom was this bridge built?”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'By whom was + O + V3' becomes 'Who + V2 + O'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “Was the door locked by him?”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Was + O + V3 + by S' becomes 'Did + S + V1 + O'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The rules must be followed by everyone.”
options: Everyone must have followed the rules.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'modal + be + V3' becomes 'modal + V1', keeping the same modal.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “I was given a gift by my uncle.”
options: My uncle gives me a gift.
My uncle gave I a gift.
My uncle gave me a gift.
My uncle had given me a gift.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'was given' becomes 'gave'; subject 'I' becomes object 'me'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “Let the work be finished at once.”
options: The work is finished at once.
Let finish the work at once.
The work will be finished at once.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Let + O + be + V3' becomes an imperative: V1 + object.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The fruits were being sold by the vendor.”
options: The vendor was selling the fruits.
The vendor is selling the fruits.
The vendor had sold the fruits.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'were being + V3' becomes 'was/were + V-ing'; singular 'vendor' takes 'was'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The bus will be driven by Murugan.”
options: Murugan will have driven the bus.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'will be + V3' becomes 'will + V1'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The poem was not written by Kalidas.”
options: Kalidas does not write the poem.
Kalidas did not wrote the poem.
Kalidas did not write the poem.
Kalidas had not written the poem.
questions.explanation: Rule: negative 'was not + V3' becomes 'did not + V1'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “Cricket is loved by Indians.”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'is loved' becomes simple present 'love' with the plural subject 'Indians'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “This house was built by my grandfather in 1950.”
options: My grandfather built this house in 1950.
My grandfather builds this house in 1950.
My grandfather had built this house in 1950.
My grandfather built this house in 1950 by him.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'was built' becomes simple past 'built'; the agent is the new subject.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The sweets have been distributed by the volunteers.”
options: The volunteers had distributed the sweets.
The volunteers have distributed the sweets.
The volunteers are distributing the sweets.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'have been + V3' becomes 'have + V3'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “Why was the meeting postponed by the director?”
options: Why does the director postpone the meeting?
Why the director postponed the meeting?
Why did the director postpone the meeting?
Why has the director postponed the meeting?
questions.explanation: Rule: 'was + V3' with a question word becomes 'did + S + V1'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The tiger was shot dead by the hunter.”
options: The hunter shoots the tiger dead.
The hunter had shot the tiger dead.
The hunter was shooting the tiger dead.
The hunter shot the tiger dead.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'was shot' becomes simple past 'shot'; the complement 'dead' stays after the object.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The matter is being discussed by the committee.”
options: The committee is discussing the matter.
The committee was discussing the matter.
The committee has discussed the matter.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'is being + V3' becomes 'is + V-ing'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “Who is being taught by Mr. Rao?”
questions.explanation: Rule: passive 'Who is being taught by X' becomes 'Whom is X teaching'; 'is being + V3' becomes 'is + V-ing', and the questioned person is the object so 'Whom'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “I was told by the doctor to take rest.”
options: The doctor tells me to take rest.
The doctor told I to take rest.
The doctor told me to take rest.
The doctor had told me to take rest.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'was told' becomes 'told'; 'I' becomes 'me'; the infinitive phrase stays.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “He is known to everyone.”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'is known to' becomes 'knows'; 'everyone' is singular; 'He' becomes 'him'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “The prize will have been won by Kiran by evening.”
options: Kiran will have won the prize by evening.
Kiran will win the prize by evening.
Kiran would have won the prize by evening.
Kiran has won the prize by evening.
questions.explanation: Rule: 'will have been + V3' becomes 'will have + V3'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “Is the new road being built by the municipality?”
options: Was the municipality building the new road?
Is the municipality building the new road?
Does the municipality build the new road?
Has the municipality built the new road?
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Is + O + being + V3 + by S' becomes 'Is + S + V-ing + O'.

questions.questionText: Choose the correct active voice of: “Let the letter be posted by him.”
questions.explanation: Rule: 'Let + O + be + V3 + by X' becomes 'Let + X (object form) + V1 + O'; 'he' becomes 'him' after 'let'.
questions.shortcut: Drop 'by', make its noun the subject, turn the be-form + V3 back to the active tense of the same time frame.
